description: Explicit decisions for specialized theme near-color pairs. Keep this file in sync with scripts/audit-theme-colors.mjs output; lower the audit baseline when a pair is merged.

decisions.reason: Tokyo Night primary background uses the canonical Tokyo base hue; #1c1c1f is the default dark/china/slate neutral surface. Merging would flatten cross-theme identity rather than remove an app-level duplicate.
decisions.reevaluateWhen: Only after a visual review proves Tokyo Night no longer needs a distinct primary background identity.

decisions.reason: China Night secondary background also feeds Monaco lineHighlight through the theme projection. Merging it into the primary background removes the visible current-line cue and flattens adjacent ink surfaces.
decisions.reevaluateWhen: Only if China Night gets a separate editor lineHighlight token or visual review proves the current-line cue remains visible.

decisions.reason: Midnight background, tertiary surface, and editor lineHighlight are adjacent in the same dark theme. Merging would weaken surface and editor-row separation.
decisions.reevaluateWhen: Only after a Midnight surface-ramp redesign removes the adjacent role split.

decisions.reason: The first value is the light xterm blue and the second is the light workbench link hover. They belong to different renderer and document interaction semantics.
decisions.reevaluateWhen: Reevaluate only when terminal ANSI and workbench link roles share a reviewed palette contract.

decisions.reason: The white overlay ladder separates subtle and stronger elevation states in dark Appearance packages; both stops are intentional adjacent-state values.
decisions.reevaluateWhen: Reevaluate when the dark Appearance overlay ladder is redesigned with focused surface-state screenshots.
